limitation: Hooks load only at CLI startup, so nothing in prompts 1-4 was captured automatically; the two ask_user exchanges and this entry were backfilled by replaying real payloads through the live scripts. Two bugs were found and fixed during testing: the redaction regex matched across JSON string boundaries and rewrote the human_decision key, and a lstrip("./") call stripped the leading dot from .github/ and broke the scan exemption. Only bash hook entries are configured, so these hooks do not run on Windows. The model and mode fields fall back to unknown/agent unless COPILOT_MODEL and COPILOT_MODE are set.
